design: see quant_agency/reward_mm.py docstring: zero-fee calm rewarded markets, passive YES+NO bids costing <= 0.98, OBI/sweep toxicity gate, passive re-pairing, zero-fee merge, published reward scoring, bid-marked inventory, 60 s checkpoints
session: one live paper session: 300 s warm-up (calm-market filter) + 2700 s live, k=40, started after this commit; if interrupted, evaluated from the last 60 s checkpoint when >= 30 live minutes elapsed, else rerun once
pass_rule: mean per-market return > 0 with t > 2.5 across the live markets (one per event) AND the 100 USD account (first markets in selection order with capital <= 100) net USD > 0, bid-marked
known_limits: short window: fill risk may be under-sampled; rewards are computed from the published formula, not received; smoke run (2 min) excluded
